description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ranawana, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320324 (24/0131)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (No. 493, Block 01) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations and title settlements.
